RUS_stalin_clear_max_advisor_trait_tiers = {
	RUS_aleksey_ustinov = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_0 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_aleksey_ustinov slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_1 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_aleksey_ustinov slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_2 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_aleksey_ustinov slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_3 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_aleksey_ustinov slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_4 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_aleksey_ustinov slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_5 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_aleksey_ustinov slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_ustinov_tier_5 }
		}
	}
	RUS_andrey_kolegayev = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_0 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_andrey_kolegayev slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_1 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_andrey_kolegayev slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_2 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_andrey_kolegayev slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_3 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_andrey_kolegayev slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_4 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_andrey_kolegayev slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_5 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_andrey_kolegayev slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kolegayev_tier_5 }
		}
	}
	RUS_irina_kakhovskaya = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_0 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_irina_kakhovskaya slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_1 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_irina_kakhovskaya slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_2 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_irina_kakhovskaya slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_3 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_irina_kakhovskaya slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_4 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_irina_kakhovskaya slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_5 }
			remove_trait = { character = RUS_irina_kakhovskaya slot = political_advisor trait = RUS_relationship_scaled_kakhovskaya_tier_5 }
		}
	}
}

RUS_stalin_apply_rkp_advisor_trait_tier = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 0.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_0_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_0 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 1.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_1_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_1 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_2_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_2 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 3.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_3_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_3 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 4.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_4_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_4 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 5.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_5_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_5 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 6.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_6_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_6 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 7.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_7_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_7 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 8.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_8_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_8 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 9.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_9_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_9 = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_10_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_10 = yes
		}
	}
}

RUS_stalin_apply_relationship_advisor_trait_tiers = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_relationship_advisor_traits_initialised } }
		RUS_stalin_clear_legacy_relationship_advisor_traits = yes
		RUS_stalin_clear_rkp_advisor_trait_tiers = yes
		RUS_stalin_clear_psr_advisor_trait_tiers = yes
		RUS_stalin_clear_max_advisor_trait_tiers = yes
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_0_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_1_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_2_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_3_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_4_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_5_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_6_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_7_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_8_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_9_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_10_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_0_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_1_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_2_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_3_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_4_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_5_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_6_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_7_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_8_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_9_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_10_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_0_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_1_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_2_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_3_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_4_active
		clr_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_5_active
		set_country_flag = RUS_relationship_advisor_traits_initialised
	}
	RUS_stalin_apply_rkp_advisor_trait_tier = yes
	RUS_stalin_apply_psr_advisor_trait_tier = yes
	RUS_stalin_apply_max_advisor_trait_tier = yes
}
